name: AI Elements
summary: Free Apache-2.0 shadcn registry of AI-native React components for the Vercel AI SDK.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of ~45 documented chatbot/workflow components — not a full inventory.
Official registry is https://elements.ai-sdk.dev/api/registry/{name}.json (NOT ai-sdk.dev/r/* which 307s to /playground).
CLI `npx ai-elements@latest add` wraps shadcn add against that API registry; @ai-elements namespace also documented.
Some comps need AI SDK / Streamdown CSS (@source for streamdown) — see per-page docs.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Message
components.summary: Chat message suite for user and assistant turns with actions and markdown responses.
components.copyCode:
npx ai-elements@latest add message

// or: npx shadcn@latest add https://elements.ai-sdk.dev/api/registry/message.json
import { Message, MessageContent, MessageActions } from "@/components/ai-elements/message"

<Message />

copyPrompt.text: Use AI Elements free Apache-2.0 component `Message` (slug `message`) from https://elements.ai-sdk.dev/components/message. Install with `npx ai-elements@latest add message` or `npx shadcn@latest add https://elements.ai-sdk.dev/api/registry/message.json` (also `npx shadcn@latest add @ai-elements/message` when namespace is configured). Registry item: https://elements.ai-sdk.dev/api/registry/message.json. Imports land under `@/components/ai-elements/message`. Requires React/Next + shadcn/ui + Tailwind; peers as listed for AI SDK apps. License: Apache-2.0 (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vercel/ai-elements/main/LICENSE; npm `ai-elements` Apache-2.0). Pricing free — open source (Vercel AI Elements).
